<thought>Only carbon shows a clear multi‑peak isotopic envelope with ~1 Da spacing and a strong M+1 peak (~11 % of the monoisotopic intensity), which matches the natural 13C abundance. No characteristic Cl, Br, or S patterns are present, and other elements have isotopic contributions too low to be seen. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
